author: jannerboy
body:
Right Guys Im Back, Staff Please Don't stop this forum because ive retired from avicus and mc for like half a year now since I got my ps4 at Christmas. I Know Some people wont bother about this post but most people know me so I just want to say that im back and everything. Sorry I haven't been leading the pvp team :(


P.S Im So Sorry Dudes but I know theres recently a TOURNAMENT  and i cant really contact cuz im not aloud skype but if its possible you guys can be in a call on skype and i promise i know what to do, if any issues do use chat if we go into the tournament. But If yu do your lucky i have a ps4 so if anyone has one send me friend request : gman142 and so on. Sorry Guys for tournament delay :(

- Janner
